snippet.title: ASUKA: The Ascent - World Premiere Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Enter Asuka’s world of intense street races across Japan’s iconic mountains. Tune and personalize JDM cars as you face fierce rivals, uncover secrets, and forge alliances. Follow a manga-inspired story filled with mystery where nothing is as it seems, until the very end.
